title: Teaching People to Think Strategically
author: Admired Leadership
summary: This article addresses a common developmental gap in emerging leaders: the inability to craft strategy. Rather than treating strategic thinking as an innate gift, the author lays out a concrete teaching method: take an existing, proven strategy apart with its original author, and work backward and forward through the decisions, origins, and pivots that shaped it. Repeating this deconstruction exercise across multiple strategies, the piece argues, gives less experienced team members a mental model for where to start and how strategy evolves through stakeholder involvement, ultimately building their capacity to craft plans of their own.
